rules.sentence: When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCT-IN` and sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to high values.

actions: MOVE 'TRANSACTIONS NOT IN ACCOUNT ORDER' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When reading `TRAN-IN` finds no more records, it reads `TRAN-IN` and sets `WS-TRAN-KEY` to high values.

When `WS-TRAN-KEY` is less than `WS-MASTER-KEY`, it sets `RJ-REASON` to `RJ-NO-ACCOUNT`, performs `3900-REJECT-TRAN`, and performs `1300-READ-TRAN`.
When `WS-TRAN-KEY` is at least `WS-MASTER-KEY` and `WS-TRAN-KEY` is `WS-MASTER-KEY`, it performs `3000-APPLY-TRAN` and performs `1300-READ-TRAN`.
When `WS-TRAN-KEY` is at least `WS-MASTER-KEY` and `WS-TRAN-KEY` is not `WS-MASTER-KEY`, it performs `4000-WRITE-MASTER` and performs `1200-READ-MASTER`.

When `TD-TRAN-CODE` is `'TR'` (`TD-TRANSFER`), it sets `WS-SAVED-TRAN` to `TRAN-RECORD`, sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-TRANSFER-CREDIT`, sets `WS-LEG-ACCT-NO` to `TD-ACCT-NO`, sets `TD-ACCT-NO` to `TD-COUNTER-ACCT-NO`, sets `TD-COUNTER-ACCT-NO` to `WS-LEG-ACCT-NO`, writes `LEGS-OUT-RECORD` from `TRAN-RECORD`, adds 1 to `WS-LEG-COUNT`, and sets `TRAN-RECORD` to `WS-SAVED-TRAN`.

When `WS-EXPECTED-TOTAL` is `WS-CLOSING-TOTAL` and `WS-MASTERS-WRITTEN` is `WS-MASTERS-READ`, it sets `WS-EXPECTED-TOTAL` to `WS-OPENING-TOTAL`, adds `WS-CREDIT-TOTAL` to `WS-EXPECTED-TOTAL`, subtracts `WS-DEBIT-TOTAL` from `WS-EXPECTED-TOTAL`, and subtracts `WS-FEE-TOTAL` from `WS-EXPECTED-TOTAL`.
